141-1893-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-8095.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1309-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-1309-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-1309-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Repeat.

When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
